t: Essentials 4-gang, surge-protected extension lead for straightforward multi-socket power distribution with 2-metre cable length and neon power indicator. Rated at 13A and 3000W capacity, this unswitched strip accommodates 4 x standard UK plugs for powering tools, appliances and equipment. Replaceable fuse protects against electrical faults, whilst wall-mounting holes enable permanent fixing to benches or walls for tidy cable management in workshops and garages. IP20 rated for indoor use with 230V operation.
b: Wall-Mounting Holes Enable Permanent Workshop Installation
Replaceable Fuse Provides Basic Electrical Fault Protection
